scope: CPU motion work, private basic skeletal material batches, unchanged-size renderer guard, boss presentation reduced16%. No gameplay, materials, GLBs, approved workshop sources, quality settings or simulation clock changes.

validation.fieldProof: Byte-identical Float32 positions/normals, world matrices and visibility against original preserved helper across8 time/mode samples on every source.
validation.memoizationProof: Every actual source and structural variant matches current-clock gait/rest/fly/run peers while retaining private geometry; independent source generation/mode/owner disposal and death tested. Cached owner revision must still match the stored revision, so seeking/mode changes/copy receipt/reset invalidate reuse.
validation.skeletalProof: Every rendered skinned world vertex and shader normal, exact attributes, original material objects, bind matrices and private skin compare equal at4 attack phases.
validation.bossProof: Every actual boss imported surface is16% smaller on each axis, including idle/death; ordinary scales and gameplay unchanged.
validation.resizeProof: 100 repeated renders allocate only1 drawing-buffer resize and1 projection update; genuine size changes still resize.

cacheCorrection.finding: Mutable cached owner changed from walk at0.2 to rest at0.4 before a new peer requested walk at0.2; mode/clock key alone could copy rest buffers.
cacheCorrection.fix: Record exact runtime poseRevision with each cache row; advance the revision on evaluation, joint/field writes, reset and copy receipt; reject a row when its owner revision changed.
regressions: walk0.2 to rest0.4 then peer walk0.2
walk0.2 to walk0.4 then peer walk0.2
rest0.2 to walk0.4 then peer rest0.2
fly0.2 to idle0.4 then peer fly0.2
walk owner receives cached rest before peer seeks old walk
rest owner receives cached walk before peer seeks old rest
walk owner explicitly resets before peer seeks old walk
same actor and same clock retains046 pause semantics, unchanged owner remains reusable

limits: CPU timing is a local Node benchmark, not target iPad FPS; root records native-browser evidence separately.
Geometry detail, original PBR materials, render resolution, shadows and every approved motion channel are preserved.
Per-mode cache owns only its newest source clock; actors retain private mutable fields.
Skeletal batches retain named original semantic surfaces for anchors/picking bounds and add private merged buffers; their disposal restores originals.
